stances.summary: Demands respect for Civil Rights Act legacy
stances.quote: The Civil Rights Act was signed in 1964 by President Johnson. Show some goddamned respect.

stances.summary: Argues judicial interpretation of law is necessary and valid
stances.quote:
Our Constitution is a living document because it requires real people to interpret laws written in a living language. 

If it were self-evident, judges would be unnecessary. 

Interpretation matters.

stances.summary: Prefers elected president to choose Supreme Court justice
stances.quote: My *preference* is that the winner of this presidential election should choose the next justice.

stances.summary: Campaigns for better future in South Carolina
stances.quote: Thank you, South Carolina, for such a warm welcome! It was inspiring to spend time with leaders and voters across the state who believe in building a better future.

stances.summary: Emphasizes Democratic unity and broad voter agreement
stances.quote: Wherever you sit in this big tent of ours, remember just how much we agree on - with each other, and with a strong majority of voters.

stances.summary: Emphasizes faith and community resilience against hatred
stances.quote:
The story of Vernon AME is not only about confronting the destructive forces of hatred. It is a story about faith, hope, and community - an enormously inspiring one. 

“We are going to survive it, and we’re going to survive it together.”

stances.summary: Affirms majority support for affordable healthcare and public services
stances.quote:
You are not alone if you believe that every American should have access to good affordable health care and the best public schools.

You are actually part of an American majority.

stances.summary: Calls for Education Secretary who supports public education and health
stances.quote: We need a Secretary of Education who actually believes in public education...and public health.

stances.summary: Links white nationalist terrorism to gun violence, calls for action
stances.quote: Our country is under attack from white nationalist terrorism, inspiring murder on our soil and abetted by weak gun laws. If we are serious about national security, we must summon the courage to name and defeat this evil.

stances.summary: Condemns dehumanizing rhetoric toward immigrants and vulnerable groups
stances.quote: You do not refer to human beings as animals. You just don’t.
